tasks.label: Copy Integration to custom_components
tasks.command: sudo rm -rf /mnt/supervisor/homeassistant/custom_components/poollab && sudo mkdir -p /mnt/supervisor/homeassistant/custom_components/poollab && sudo cp -r /addons/Poollab/custom_components/poollab/* /mnt/supervisor/homeassistant/custom_components/poollab/ && echo 'Copied integration to /mnt/supervisor/homeassistant/custom_components/poollab'

tasks.label: Start HA Core
tasks.command: sudo mkdir -p /run/supervisor && ha supervisor info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Supervisor is not running. Run Start Home Assistant first.'; exit 1; }; output=$(ha core start 2>&1); exit_code=$?; if [ $exit_code -ne 0 ]; then echo "$output"; case "$output" in *"Another job is running for job group home_assistant_core"*|*"Home Assistant Core is already running"*) echo 'HA Core is already running'; exit 0;; esac; exit $exit_code; fi; [ -n "$output" ] && echo "$output"; echo 'HA Core start command sent'

tasks.label: Restart HA Core
tasks.command: sudo mkdir -p /run/supervisor && ha supervisor info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Supervisor is not running. Run Start Home Assistant first.'; exit 1; }; max_attempts=24; attempt=1; while [ $attempt -le $max_attempts ]; do output=$(ha core restart 2>&1); exit_code=$?; if [ $exit_code -eq 0 ]; then [ -n "$output" ] && echo "$output"; echo 'HA Core restart command sent'; exit 0; fi; case "$output" in *"Another job is running for job group home_assistant_core"*) if [ $attempt -eq $max_attempts ]; then echo 'Timed out waiting for Home Assistant Core to become restartable'; echo "$output"; exit 1; fi; echo "HA Core busy; waiting to retry restart ($attempt/$max_attempts)"; attempt=$((attempt + 1)); sleep 5;; *"Home Assistant Core is not running"*) output=$(ha core start 2>&1); exit_code=$?; if [ $exit_code -eq 0 ]; then [ -n "$output" ] && echo "$output"; echo 'HA Core start command sent'; exit 0; fi; echo "$output"; exit $exit_code;; *) echo "$output"; exit $exit_code;; esac; done; echo 'Failed to restart Home Assistant Core'; exit 1;

tasks.label: Recover HA Supervisor + Core
tasks.command: sudo mkdir -p /run/supervisor && ha supervisor restart >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Failed to request Supervisor restart'; exit 1; }; supervisor_attempts=36; while [ $supervisor_attempts -gt 0 ]; do if ha supervisor info >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi; supervisor_attempts=$((supervisor_attempts - 1)); if [ $supervisor_attempts -eq 0 ]; then echo 'Timed out waiting for Home Assistant Supervisor'; exit 1; fi; echo 'Waiting for Home Assistant Supervisor to come back...'; sleep 5; done; core_attempts=36; while [ $core_attempts -gt 0 ]; do output=$(ha core start 2>&1); exit_code=$?; if [ $exit_code -eq 0 ]; then [ -n "$output" ] && echo "$output"; echo 'HA Core recovery command sent'; exit 0; fi; case "$output" in *"Another job is running for job group home_assistant_core"*|*"EOF"*|*"connect: connection refused"*) core_attempts=$((core_attempts - 1)); if [ $core_attempts -eq 0 ]; then echo 'Timed out waiting for Home Assistant Core recovery'; echo "$output"; exit 1; fi; echo 'Waiting for Home Assistant Core recovery...'; sleep 5;; *"Home Assistant Core is already running"*) echo 'HA Core is already running'; exit 0;; *) echo "$output"; exit $exit_code;; esac; done; echo 'Failed to recover Home Assistant Core'; exit 1;

tasks.label: Start Home Assistant
tasks.command: command -v supervisor_run >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Not inside Home Assistant dev container. Reopen in container first.'; exit 1; }; for f in /usr/bin/supervisor*; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; sudo chmod a+x "$f"; done; sudo mkdir -p /run/supervisor && sudo -E supervisor_run
